definitions.explanation: To a significant degree. Used as an adverb to emphasize extent.
Matching or equal to something in value or level.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{相当|そうとう}{寒|さむ}いです。
{相当|そうとう}な{努力|どりょく}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
この{金額|きんがく}は{千|せん}ドルに{相当|そうとう}します。
examples.english: This amount is equivalent to 1,000 dollars.

notes:
{相当|そうとう} can function as an adverb, na-adjective, or suru verb.

USAGE PATTERNS:
- Adverb: {相当|そうとう} + adjective/verb (considerably)
- Na-adjective: {相当|そうとう}な + noun (considerable)
- Suru verb: ～に{相当|そうとう}する (be equivalent to)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {相当|そうとう}{難|むずか}しい (quite difficult)
- {相当|そうとう}な{量|りょう} (considerable amount)
- Xに{相当|そうとう}する (be equivalent to X)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- かなり: fairly, considerably (casual)
- {相当|そうとう}: considerably (slightly more formal)
- {非常|ひじょう}に: extremely (stronger)
